crossRefs.note: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says…
Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to…
Then send them to the king of Edom, to the king of Moab, to the king of the children of Ammon, to the king of Tyre, and…
Yahweh’s word which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.
It was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to…

translations.web: Then I took the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:
translations.bsb: So I took the cup from the LORD’s hand and made all the nations drink from it, each one to whom the LORD had sent me,
translations.kjv: Then took I the cup at the LORD'S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent
translations.asv: Then took I the cup at Jehovah's hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom Jehovah had sent me:
